run_protobuf_benchmark: run a protobuf serialization and deserialization benchmark on provided data files via CLI
run_one_test: run a single benchmark test on a protobuf dataset file and return throughput results
init_benchmark_data: initialize benchmark data by parsing a protobuf dataset file into message objects
parse_from_benchmark: benchmark protobuf message deserialization by calling ParseFromString on serialized payloads
Benchmark_run_benchmark: run a timed benchmark using timeit and return throughput in MB per second
